name.value: Super 8 by Wyndham West Kelowna BC

description.value: Super 8 by Wyndham West Kelowna BC is a franchise motel located on Westgate Road in West Kelowna, part of the Wyndham Hotels & Resorts family. Situated near the Okanagan Lake corridor, it serves as a practical overnight stop for cyclists touring the wine country routes and rail trails of the central Okanagan. As a Super 8 property it offers standard motel-style accommodation with direct road access.
